description: This file defines the Cache class with helper methods for cache management in Drupal, including merging contexts, tags, max-ages, building tags, invalidating tags, and retrieving cache bins.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: Helper class providing static methods for cache context, tag, max-age merging, tag building, invalidation, and cache bin retrieval in Drupal.

methods.name: mergeContexts
methods.description: Merges multiple cache context lists, removes duplicates, and validates tokens.

methods.name: mergeTags
methods.description: Merges multiple cache tag lists, removes duplicates, and asserts all are strings.

methods.name: mergeMaxAges
methods.description: Merges max-age values, returning the lowest, considering infinite max-age.

methods.name: buildTags
methods.description: Builds cache tags from a prefix and suffixes, concatenated with a glue.

methods.name: invalidateTags
methods.description: Invalidates cache items associated with specified tags.

methods.name: getMemoryBins
methods.description: Retrieves all memory cache bin services.
